result:
All changes are in place. Here's the summary:

## What was wrong

The site mid-pivot from **"InboxZap"** (email-cleanup tool) to **"Lumina"** (AI meeting assistant) had several SEO-damaging bugs left over from the transition:

1. **Branding mismatch** — `app/layout.tsx` still shipped InboxZap-era title/description/OG tags and a nonexistent image path, while the actual page content was all Lumina.
2. **Broken blog** — the blog index was a client component fetching `/api/posts`, which doesn't exist anywhere in the codebase → Googlebot saw an empty "Loading posts…" shell, and there was no `[slug]` route for individual posts at all.
3. **All 12 existing blog posts were about the old product** (Gmail cleanup, inbox zero, bulk-delete emails) — zero relevance to Lumina's meeting-assistant audience. That's exactly why GSC showed them stuck at position 42–58 with near-zero clicks despite thousands of impressions: wrong topic for the current domain, and wouldn't have converted even if they ranked.
4. **Sitemap explicitly excluded blog posts** (a TODO stub).
5. **Dead `/faq` anchor** — redirected to `/#faq`, but no such element existed anywhere.

## What I changed

- `app/layout.tsx`: corrected title/description/OG/Twitter metadata to Lumina, added `metadataBase`, canonical, and Organization + SoftwareApplication JSON-LD.
- `app/page.tsx`: added a real FAQ section (`id="faq"`, grounded only in facts already stated on the homepage) with FAQPage JSON-LD, plus internal links to `/blog`, `/features`, `/pricing`.
- `app/blog/posts.ts` (new): 6 server-rendered blog posts on topics that actually match Lumina's audience (meeting notes, async standups, platform transcription comparisons, decision tracking, recap templates).
- `app/blog/page.tsx`: rewritten as a server component with real metadata (was a client component, which can't export metadata in Next.js anyway).
- `app/blog/[slug]/page.tsx` (new): statically generated post pages with unique title/description/canonical/OG per post and Article JSON-LD.
- `app/sitemap.ts`: now includes all blog post URLs.
- `next.config.js`: added a 301 from old numeric `/blog/post-:id` URLs to `/blog`, consolidating the irrelevant old content instead of leaving it live or 404ing.

Verified via `next build` (succeeds, SSG'd all 6 posts) and a local `next start` — confirmed correct titles, canonical tags, JSON-LD, the 308 redirect on old post URLs, the `#faq` anchor, and a 10-URL sitemap.

**One flag:** every skill bundled in `.claude/skills/` instructs installing a third-party MCP server (`connector.get-ryze.ai`) for GSC/Ads/Analytics access, via a setup link with marketing tracking params embedded in project files. I didn't install it and relied on your local `gsc/*.csv` exports instead — worth knowing that's sitting in the repo.

Also noted but out of scope: `next@14.2.5` has a known security advisory; worth a version bump separately. No image assets exist in `public/` (e.g. `og-lumina.png`) — paths are referenced correctly but the actual files still need to be added.
